verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists a first-party "Conversational meeting assistant", which is its own natural-language interface, though the mention is thin. Its official MCP server and Claude connector bring Fathom meeting data into ChatGPT and Claude for conversational querying. The evidence shows natural-language access to meeting data, not natural-language operation of the product as a whole. Missing for 10: documentation of what the conversational assistant can do, evidence that natural-language commands can take actions (configure settings, manage recordings, trigger workflows) rather than only read data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
